name: Sikalastic-622 Excel Top PLUS
paste:
SIKALASTIC®-622 EXCEL TOP PLUS: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-622 Excel Top PLUS, April 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikalastic_-622_exceltopplus.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-622 Excel Top PLUS where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sikalastic®-622 Excel Top PLUS is a single component, aliphatic, moisture cured, elastomeric polyurethane coating for use as an exposed trafficable wear and top coat typically applied over Sikalastic® polyurethane and polyurea waterproofing membranes. Sikalastic®- 622 Excel Top PLUS provides superior UV resistance and colour stability.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikalastic®-622 Excel Top PLUS may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Decks and ramps for pedestrians
    - Foot bridges and walkways
    - Mechanical rooms
    - Stadiums and arenas
    - Plaza and rooftop decks
    - Balconies
    - Top coat for SikaRoof® MTC-12 UV system
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-622 Excel Top PLUS
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Single component, aliphatic, high-performance polyurethane top coat
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. AS4654.1 2012- Waterproofing membranes for external above-ground use (BRANZ)
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS4654.1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Superior colour and gloss retention
    - UV resistant- good resistance to yellowing
    - One component- no mixing required and easy to use
    - Easy to clean and maintain
    - Outstanding resistance to abrasion and wear
    - Resistant to water and de-icing salts
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: Grey (Resembles RAL 7040)
    - Viscosity: 1,000 ± 300 cps @ 27°C
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: <250 gm/liter (ASTM D-2369-81)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Solid content by volume: 74 ± 3% (ASTM D-2697)
    - Shore A hardness: 90 ± 5 (ASTM D-2240)
    - Tensile strength: 18.6 ± 1.4 MPa (ASTM D-412)
    - Tensile strain at break: 250 ± 50 % (24oC and 50% R.H.) (ASTM D-412)
2.7 System structure. Please refer to the SikaRoof® MTC-12 UV system data sheet for typical roof top membrane system build up.
2.8 Dry film thickness. Dry film thickness (DFT): 350 micron
2.9 Consumption. Wet film thickness (WFT): 475 micron; Approximately 40m2 per 18.9L pail
2.10 Substrate temperature. The substrate temperature must be a minimum of 3°C above due point during application and cure.
2.11 Substrate moisture content. Substrate moisture content should not exceed 6% by weight, determine maximum moisture content of substrate with a Tramex CME or CM Expert type concrete moisture meter.
2.12 Waiting time to overcoating. Sikalastic®-622 Excel Top PLUS may be recoated with another layer after the previous coat is tack free, up to a maximum interval of 48 hours after the application of the preceding coat. In case of rain or if the overcoating interval has been exceeded, the surface must be lightly abraded and wiped with Sika® Thinner C, allow to flash off prior to application of the next layer. In the event of unforeseen rain event or delays beyond the stated recoat window referenced in each product’s current PDS, observe the following.
    | Product | Recoat Window | Surface Prep when Re- |
    | coat Window exceeded |
    | Sikalastic® -488 | Tack free to 48 hours | Abrade, Clean and wipe |
    | with Sika® Thinner C |
    | Sika®-622 Top PLUS | Tack free to 48 hours | Lightly abrade, Clean |
    | and Wipe with Sika® Thinner |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.13 Drying time. Allow 16 hours between coats. Allow longer in adverse weather conditions.
2.14 Applied product ready for use. Allow a minimum of 72 hours curing prior to pedestrian traffic.
2.15 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 18.9 Litre metal pails
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of manufacture in original, sealed containers, if the storage conditions are met.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry, weatherproof environment, protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. All surfaces to be waterproofed must be firm, clean, dry, structurally sound and smooth. All grease, oil, wax, curing compounds, dust, loose material, laitance and other contaminants must be removed. All projections and rough spots should be dressed off to achieve a level surface. The substrate surface must be continuous and not pond water. If in doubt apply a test area first Sika® Polyurethane Base Coat and Top Coats – Coating should be cured and tack free.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Mixing. Thoroughly mix coating using a mechanical mixer at slow speed until a homogenous mixture and uniform colour is obtained (typically 1 minute). Use care not to allow the entrapment of air into the mixture.
4.3 Application. Apply at the recommended coverage rate (see appropriate System Guide) using a notched squeegee or trowel, and backroll using a phenolic resin core roller. Allow coating to cure a minimum of 16 hours at 20°C and 50 % R.H. or until tack fee between coats. Allow coating to cure for a minimum of 72 hours before opening to pedestrian traffic.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Remove liquid coating immediately with a dry cloth, clean tools and equipment with Sika® Colma Cleaner while the material is still wet. Use disposable brushes and roller sleeves. Cured coating can only be removed mechanically.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations - Limitations.
    - Concrete must be allowed to cure for a minimum of 28 days, depending on curing and drying conditions.
    - To avoid dew point conditions during application, relative humidity must be no more than 95% and substrate temperature must be at least 3°C above measured dew point temperatures.
    - Ambient and substrate temperature during application and cure must be a minimum of 5°C and a maximum of 35°C.
    - Do not store materials outdoors exposed to sunlight for prolonged periods.
    - Product is ready for use, do not dilute or thin with solvents.
    - Use properly graded, oven dried aggregates only.
    - Do not apply to a porous or damp surface where moisture vapour transmission will occur during application and cure.
    - Do not apply if it is raining or if rain is imminent within 8–12 hours of application.
    - Allow sufficient time for the substrate to dry after rain or inclement weather.
    - When applying over existing coatings compatibility and adhesion testing is recommended.
    - Opening to pedestrian traffic or installation of separate wear course prior to final cure may result in loss of aggregate or permanent staining and subsequent premature failure.
    - Not suitable for vehicular traffic.
    - Unvented metal pan decks or decks containing between-slab membranes require further technical evaluation and priming with a moisture blocking primer - contact Sika regarding recommendations.
    - Do not subject to continuous immersion.
    - Base coat must be kept clean and recoated within 48 hours, If this window is exceeded, contact Sika for recommendations.
    - Mockups to verify application methods and substrate conditions as well as desired slip resistance and aesthetics are recommended.
    - Contact Sika Technical Service for advice if further information is required.
4.6 Further information.
    - Safety Data Sheet (SDS)
    - Sika Method Statement: SikaRoof® MTC-UV systems

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.5):
    - To avoid dew point conditions during application, relative humidity must be no more than 95% and substrate temperature must be at least 3°C above measured dew point temperatures.
    - Ambient and substrate temperature during application and cure must be a minimum of 5°C and a maximum of 35°C.
    - Do not apply to a porous or damp surface where moisture vapour transmission will occur during application and cure.
    - Do not apply if it is raining or if rain is imminent within 8–12 hours of application.
    - Allow sufficient time for the substrate to dry after rain or inclement weather.
    - Unvented metal pan decks or decks containing between-slab membranes require further technical evaluation and priming with a moisture blocking primer - contact Sika regarding recommendations.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - All surfaces to be waterproofed must be firm, clean, dry, structurally sound and smooth. All grease, oil, wax, curing compounds, dust, loose material, laitance and other contaminants must be removed. All projections and rough spots should be dressed off to achieve a level surface. The substrate surface must be continuous and not pond water. If in doubt apply a test area first Sika® Polyurethane Base Coat and Top Coats – Coating should be cured and tack free.
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Solid content by volume: 74 ± 3% (ASTM D-2697)
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: <250 gm/liter (ASTM D-2369-81)
    - Shore A hardness: 90 ± 5 (ASTM D-2240)
    - Tensile strength: 18.6 ± 1.4 MPa (ASTM D-412)
    - Tensile strain at break: 250 ± 50 % (24oC and 50% R.H.) (ASTM D-412)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-622 Excel Top PLUS, April 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikalastic_-622_exceltopplus.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikalastic®-622 Excel Top PLUS, version 09/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sds-sikalastic-622exceltopplus.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
